messages:
michael-docs: Heads-up from today's onboarding :point_up: — the quickstart README in `starter-apps` has a small but frustrating copy/paste drift. The curl example uses `Authorization: Token $REDWOOD_KEY` while docker-compose and SDK snippets use `REDWOOD_API_KEY` and expect a Bearer header. New users hit 401 immediately.

tara-devex: Oof. Can you paste the exact curl block so I can patch it?

chris-se: Repro steps: git clone, docker-compose up, follow README -> run curl -> 401. Compose maps `REDWOOD_API_KEY` into the container but README shows `export REDWOOD_KEY` and `Token` header.

michael-docs: Current problematic snippet:

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Authorization: Token $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-mini","input":"hey"}'
```

chris-se: Also, the README text says "SDKs retry on transient failures" which is ambiguous. Our SDKs only do limited retries by default; production apps should set explicit retry/backoff settings.

evan-qa: And one more: the Go snippet uses an old ctor `client.New(ctx, apiKey)` while current is `client.NewClient(ctx, client.WithAPIKey(apiKey))` — causes copy/paste confusion in workshops.

tara-devex: I'll open a tiny PR to: (1) standardize env var to `REDWOOD_API_KEY`, (2) change curl header to `Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY`, (3) update the Go/JS/Python examples to current ctor shapes, and (4) replace vague retry line with: "SDKs provide limited automatic retries for transient errors; configure retry/backoff explicitly for production via SDK options." I'll add a one-line Troubleshooting: "401 -> verify env var name and that Authorization uses Bearer <KEY>."

chris-se: Please include before/after snippets in the PR description and add a tiny smoke job that runs the curl against a mock server in CI so future edits don't regress.

pr-bot: PR opened by tara-devex: https://github.com/redwood-inference/starter-apps/pull/56  CI: lint + sample-smoke-test started.

michael-docs: Thanks! After merge we'll update the quickstart landing and add a changelog entry so support can close the related tickets. This should remove a bunch of first-day friction. :raised_hands:
